what: zod must be pinned to match MCP SDK's version exactly. MCP SDK @1.29.0 uses zod@4.x internally — if aide-v0 uses zod@3.x, TypeScript throws TS2589 "Type instantiation is excessively deep" on server.tool() calls. Fix: npm install zod@4.3.6 (or whatever version MCP SDK resolves). Also posthog-node SDK causes the same TS2589 conflict — use plain HTTP fetch to PostHog /batch endpoint instead.
why: Spent significant time debugging build failures. The root cause was npm install resolving a newer zod that MCP SDK depended on differently. This will recur on any npm install if not pinned.
